mainfilter.txt.title: HiSkyZen's Compat'n'UtilKit — Main Filter
mainfilter.txt.description: Microsoft Edge/Copilot compatibility exceptions and miscellaneous website fixes for AdGuard network filtering.
mainfilter.txt.destination: Ad Blocking > Custom Filters (import local TXT or subscribe by URL)
mainfilter.txt.expires: 1 day (subscription filters; not meaningful for manually applied exclusions)

fl.txt.title: HiSkyZen's Compat'n'UtilKit — Lover938 Optional Fixes
fl.txt.description: Optional lover938.net resource blocks, scriptlets and JavaScript rules. Do NOT enable in AdGuard for Windows or Android per original source warning. Trusted filters may be required.
fl.txt.destination: Supported AdGuard browser-extension filters ONLY; do not enable in Windows or Android apps
fl.txt.expires: 1 day (subscription filters; not meaningful for manually applied exclusions)

HTTPSexclusions.txt.title: HiSkyZen's Compat'n'UtilKit — HTTPS Exclusions
HTTPSexclusions.txt.description: Domain exceptions to HTTPS inspection/interception (includes subdomains); not a network-filter subscription.
HTTPSexclusions.txt.format: AdGuard HTTPS exclusions (domain list with # comments)
HTTPSexclusions.txt.destination: AdGuard for Windows > Settings > Network settings > HTTPS filtering > Exclusions
HTTPSexclusions.txt.expires: 1 day (subscription filters; not meaningful for manually applied exclusions)

dnsfilter.txt.title: HiSkyZen's Compat'n'UtilKit — DNS Allowlist Filter
dnsfilter.txt.description: AdGuard DNS-filtering exception rules for Microsoft domains; does NOT bypass the configured DNS server. Use DNSexclusions.txt for resolver bypass.
dnsfilter.txt.destination: AdGuard DNS Protection > DNS filters > Import custom filter
dnsfilter.txt.expires: 1 day (subscription filters; not meaningful for manually applied exclusions)

DNSexclusions.txt.title: HiSkyZen's Compat'n'UtilKit — DNS Exclusions
DNSexclusions.txt.description: Bare domain list for AdGuard for Windows advanced DNS exclusions; uses system resolver instead of configured AdGuard DNS. No inline comments for maximum import compatibility.
DNSexclusions.txt.destination: AdGuard for Windows > Settings > App settings > Advanced settings > DNS exclusions
DNSexclusions.txt.expires: 1 day (subscription filters; not meaningful for manually applied exclusions)
